installation: the release wheel in an environment outside the checkout
title: Small finite metalens: full-aperture field, three deterministic starts refined by the shape VJP, mesh, time and propagation-model checks

starts: every ridge one library step wider where allowed

refinement.parameters: ridge widths through the shape VJP
refinement.step_count: in every iteration a forward run of the current design finds the 1e-3 stop, and the value and gradient run for that fixed step count

validation.propagation: angular spectrum from the aperture line y = -7.9 um to the focal line y = 5.6 um and the axis
validation.longer_time: twice the stop time of the 1e-3 rule, capped at 10 times the declared window

fixture.time_rule: every forward run, of the lens and of the bare cell, continues until the total field energy in the cell (the native StateDiagnostics measure) falls below 1e-3 of its peak after the source has ended, checked every 20 steps, capped at 10 times the declared 303.6 fs window

reference_method: the direct full-wave DFT lines; the angular-spectrum propagation is checked against them

acceptance.performance: best refined design focusing efficiency at least 0.5571
acceptance.mesh: 0.0125 um changes the focusing efficiency by at most 0.02 and the axial peak by at most 0.1 um
acceptance.time: doubling the stop time changes the focusing efficiency by at most 0.005
acceptance.propagation: propagated and direct focal-line intensities within 5 percent relative L2
acceptance.psf: focal-line FWHM of the best design at most 1.25 lambda / (2 NA) = 1.76 um
acceptance.scope: a unit-cell phase library alone is never reported as a full-lens validation

supersedes.status: the original case stays in place; its failing runs are kept outside the repository by owner decision

revision.reason: the declared 303.6 fs window ends while the lens still holds energy in the ridge array: at 1x the cell holds 1.7e-2 (library) to 1.85e-2 (refined) of its peak energy, so the efficiency depends on where the window ends (changes of 0.005 to 0.039 between 1x and 1.5x, and oscillations of 0.005 up to 4x), and a refinement at that window optimizes a truncated response
revision.evidence: energy stop study: 98 to 99 percent of the energy left at 10x sits within 0.5 um of the ridge layer (a slowly leaking array mode, not absorber reflection); the library design gives 0.55672 at the 1e-3 stop (3.46x) and 0.55671 at the 1e-4 stop (7.77x), and the native auto-shutoff at 1e-4 gives 0.55672; the refined narrower design reaches 1e-3 at 4.97x
